description: SPLIT(string, delimiter) splits into a VARIANT ARRAY of substrings. The delimiter is LITERAL, not a regex, so '.' splits on a dot rather than on any character; trailing empty parts are kept; an empty delimiter yields the whole string as one element; a multi-character delimiter works; and a NULL argument on either side yields NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/SplitTest (now retired); the ARRAY results are read through TO_JSON so the assertion lands on a VARCHAR no transport reformats.
